meaning: `pv_panel` defaults to `baseline=false`, so pressure-volume panels plot absolute compartment volume; only callers passing `baseline=true` re-zero y at the window's first sample. That re-zeroing exists for the combined panel, where two different compartments' absolute levels are not comparable but their excursions are.

could_move.what: A panel that overlays two compartments without baseline=true keeps one trace near 98 mL and the other near 20 mL, so the shared y axis flattens the smaller excursion
Two-model comparison decks are the likely place this bites, since they draw paired traces
Replot entry points regenerate every panel through this default, so the effect is deck-wide

expectation: Unknown in size. Direction: baseline=false preserves absolute volume offsets; baseline=true shows excursions only. Which panels currently pass the flag cannot be told from this context.

check.why: Replots one two-model deck without re-fitting, so the PV panel y axis and its baseline convention can be inspected directly.
